shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright slab/pillar face
figures concentrated in an upper register with a larger plain field below
horizontal band or register divider with repeated linear elements
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs bearing shallow relief in which small profile creatures and a fringed, radiating band-like motif are clustered in the upper zone above a broad, largely undecorated field, a fairly specific compositional scheme with schematic, outline-and-flat-relief animals. However, B shows an identifiable sequence — row of arch/U signs, a fringed band, quadrupeds and a crouching figure, and a large long-necked bird in profile on the lower shaft — while A's carving is confined to a narrow upper strip whose figures are indistinct, so no single motif can be matched element for element.
